content_sections.heading: Dr. N.C. Joshi Memorial Hospital Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Dr. N.C. Joshi Memorial Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Dr. N.C. Joshi Memorial Hospital is scheduled for 30th July 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Senior Resident positions, candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a PG Degree/Diploma or equivalent in the concerned specialty, recognized by the NMC, and must be registered with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Dr. N.C. Joshi Memorial Hospital has announced a total of 4 vacancies for the Senior Resident positions. These vacancies are distributed across different specialties as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST candidates (05 years) and OBC candidates (03 years) as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident posts will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 208,700 per month, as per the pay matrix and government norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for the Senior Resident posts at Dr. N.C. Joshi Memorial Hospital. Both General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts will primarily involve an Interview and Document Verification. Candidates are advised to be prepared for these stages.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including educational certificates, degree/diploma certificates, NMC registration, experience certificates (if any), category certificates (if applicable), and recent passport-size photographs. Self-attested photocopies of all documents are also required.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Dr. N.C. Joshi Memorial Hospital, New Delhi - 110005. Candidates are advised to confirm the exact reporting time and venue details from the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or ad-hoc position?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Senior Resident posts is on an ad-hoc basis. Candidates should refer to the official notification for more details regarding the tenure and terms of employment.
